svg.title: The planning corridor, and the ward that is not open
svg.desc: A hospital corridor with beds in it, a capacity board, a waiting-list whiteboard, a three-year plan on a screen, a building hoarding and a sign for an unopened ward.

g.text: The planning corridor, and the ward that is not open
Eleven things to find. Three of them are predictions, and two were due last year.
the ward that was due last year
